existing.name: Kipling Camp
existing.issue: name is real (1982-founded), but the source URLs all point to Banjaar Tola (Taj Safari) — name/source mismatch. Use Banjaar Tola for the luxury slot; Kipling Camp is appropriate as a separate stay-row but at ₹45-65k it is mispriced (Kipling is ₹15-30k mid-luxury, not Banjaar-Tola tier).

replacement.name: Banjaar Tola (A Taj Safari Lodge)
replacement.tagline: Taj Safari's Kanha flagship — 18 luxury tented suites in two camps along the Banjar river. Open verandahs face the water; naturalist-led drives into Mukki zone. Closed monsoon (Jun 30 - Oct 1).
replacement.address: Mukki, Kanha National Park, Balaghat District 481111, Madhya Pradesh

existing.name: Kanh Jungle Resort
existing.issue: fabricated — 'Kanh Jungle Resort' (note spelling: Kanh, not Kanha) is not verifiable on Booking, MMT, or Tripadvisor as a single property. Listicle ghost. Replace with MPT Baghira Jungle Resort Mocha, the real Khatia-side state-tourism property.

replacement.name: MPT Baghira Jungle Resort Mocha
replacement.tagline: MP Tourism's flagship Khatia-side property (opened 2014 to replace the original Baghira Log Huts inside the core zone, closed by Supreme Court order 2016). Cottages and AC rooms, multi-cuisine restaurant. Book direct via mptourism.com.
replacement.address: Mocha Village, near Khatia/Kisli Gate, Kanha National Park, Mandla District 481768

existing.name: Kanha Safari Lodge
existing.issue: verify — generic name; the real MPT property near Mukki is 'MPT Safari Lodge Mukki' (not 'Kanha Safari Lodge'). Replace to match the verified mpstdc.com listing. The 'Kanha Safari Lodge' as priced (₹18-28k) is overpriced — actual MPT Mukki is ₹2-4k value tier.

replacement.name: MPT Safari Lodge Mukki
replacement.tagline: MP Tourism's Mukki-side property — beside the Banjar river surrounded by dense forest. Rooms with forest views, bird-watching from the property, the closest formal accommodation to Mukki Gate. Less crowded than the Khatia-side MPT.
replacement.address: Mukki Gate, Kanha National Park, Balaghat District 481111, Madhya Pradesh

existing.name: Bamni Dadar Jungle Camp
existing.issue: fabricated — 'Bamni Dadar' is a sunset viewpoint inside Kanha's core zone; no lodge by this name exists. Listicle ghost confusing the viewpoint with a property. Replace with Shergarh Tented Camp, Kanha's actual owner-operated 6-tent boutique camp.

replacement.name: Shergarh Tented Camp
replacement.tagline: Owner-operated 6-tent boutique camp on a 9-acre forest plot near Khatia gate — one of Kanha's most awarded eco-lodges. Knowledgeable naturalists, family-run kitchen, no children under 12. Closed Jun 16 - Oct 16.
replacement.address: Village Baherakhar, near Khatia Gate, Kanha National Park, Mandla 481768
